Make only five local differences: (1) The mouse's white sail wraps partway around its wooden mast instead of billowing wholly away, continuous cloth. (5) The blue buttons on the mouse's yellow coat reverse their top-to-bottom order of size, retaining the same two buttons. No other edits, no disconnected objects, text or watermark.
